info.name: Kadahapola ERP API
info.description: Complete API collection for Kadahapola ERP System — Batches 3–5 + Procurement + Inventory

item.name: Procurement
item.description: Full purchasing lifecycle: Purchase Requests → Purchase Orders → Goods Receipts → Purchase Invoices

request.description: Transitions DRAFT → CONFIRMED. Auto-creates a DRAFT Purchase Invoice.
po_id is optional. If provided, the PO's invoice must be in DRAFT or CANCELLED status.
Updates stock ledger and auto-appends lines to the PO's DRAFT invoice.
po_line_id links to the PO line for 3-way match pricing on the invoice.
Manual invoice creation. An invoice is also auto-created when a PO is confirmed.
Transitions DRAFT → POSTED. Emits procurement.invoice.posted event.
Partial or full payment. Emits procurement.payment.recorded event.
DRAFT invoice only. Lines are also auto-appended when a linked GRN is confirmed.

item.name: Inventory
item.description: Full inventory lifecycle: Material Requests → Goods Transfers → Goods Issues → Stock Adjustments → Quality Checks → Stock Balance

body.description: quantity can be negative for deduction
